description: This file contains utility functions for handling copy and paste operations within table structures in a ProseMirror-based editor, including pasting cells, ensuring rectangular shape, clipping, growing tables, and inserting cells.

methods.name: pastedCells
methods.description: Extracts a rectangular area of cells from a slice, or returns null if the slice isn't a table or row.

methods.name: ensureRectangular
methods.description: Ensures that a set of table rows forms a rectangular shape, adjusting widths and adding empty cells as needed.

methods.name: fitSlice
methods.description: Creates a node of a given type filled with a slice, replacing the node's content.

methods.name: clipCells
methods.description: Clips or extends a set of cells to match specified width and height, handling rowspan and colspan adjustments.

methods.name: growTable
methods.description: Expands a table to at least the specified width and height by adding rows or columns.

methods.name: isolateHorizontal
methods.description: Splits cells crossing a horizontal line to prevent crossing rowspan cells.

methods.name: isolateVertical
methods.description: Splits cells crossing a vertical line to prevent crossing colspan cells.

methods.name: insertCells
methods.description: Inserts a block of pasted cells into a table at a specified rectangle, adjusting table size and cell spans.
